peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 6.2% below its local comparables; 36 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (89.8): 6.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 97 of 108 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 58.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $920,500 ($1,367 psf, 635–710 sq ft; 6 resales, Dec 2023–Nov 2025); 6 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,535 psf (range $1,336–2,086); 10.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $113,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,260,000 ($1,343 psf, 893–968 sq ft; 7 resales, Jul 2025–Jun 2026); 3 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,365 psf (range $1,344–2,074); 1.6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $21,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Khatib MRT about 920 m, Yishun MRT about 1,430 m; closer than 30 of 116 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest Northland Primary School about 340 m; more than 39 of 116 similar developments (the same as 35). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 690 m), more than 81 of 116 similar developments (the same as 17); nearest hawker centre Yishun Park Hawker Centre about 860 m; nearest park Yishun Park about 470 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 11 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 201 resales (201 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Chencharu Close (government land sale site, awarded, about 875 homes), about 1,420 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 201 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 17 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 201 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 252 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−20.2%). Planning-area private resales −19%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
